title: Beyond the Personal Assistant: How Expectations for Enterprise AI in Teamwork Diverged as Generative AI Took Shape, 2023-2025
abstract: arXiv:2509.10956v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: HCI often draws on users' articulated needs and expectations to explore design opportunities for emerging technologies. Yet, these accounts are shaped by how technologies take form over time. We examine this dynamic through a two-phase interview study of enterprise AI in a project-based software development organization. We interviewed 15 practitioners in 2023 and re-interviewed 10 in 2025. In 2023, participants expected enterprise AI built around teams: systems integrating signals across workplace tools, detecting coordination problems, and intervening in team processes. By 2025, no such team-focused systems had entered their work, while personal AI assistants were prevalent. These expectations diverged from one another: some expectations were deferred, some rejected as undesirable or infeasible, and some no longer articulated as expectations they had held. These trajectories show how design possibilities can remain open-ended

translated_title: 超越个人助理：2023-2025年间，随着生成式AI的成形，企业AI在团队协作中的期望如何产生分歧
translated_abstract: 人机交互（HCI）领域通常借鉴用户明确表达的需求和期望来探索新兴技术的设计机会。然而，这些表述会随着技术随时间演变成形而被塑造。我们通过对一家基于项目的软件开发组织中的企业AI进行两阶段访谈研究来考察这一动态过程。我们在2023年访谈了15名从业者，并在2025年对其中10人进行了再次访谈。2023年，参与者期望企业AI以团队为中心构建：即能够整合跨工作场所工具的信号、检测协调问题并干预团队流程的系统。到2025年，没有任何此类以团队为中心的系统进入他们的工作，而个人AI助理却已普及。这些期望彼此产生了分化：一些期望被搁置，一些因不受欢迎或不可行而被拒绝，还有一些不再被表述为他们曾经持有的期望。这些演变轨迹表明，设计的可能性如何能够保持开放性。
tldr: 通过2023年和2025年对软件开发从业者的两阶段访谈，研究发现随着生成式AI的发展，企业AI从最初被期望以团队协作为中心（整合工作工具信号、检测协调问题）演变为个人AI助理占主导地位的现实，且最初的团队期望分化为被搁置、被拒绝或被遗忘的不同轨迹。
en_tdlr: Through two-phase interviews with software practitioners in 2023 and 2025, this study reveals that as generative AI took shape, enterprise AI diverged from initial team-centered expectations (integrating workplace signals and detecting coordination problems) toward a reality dominated by personal AI assistants, with team expectations deferred, rejected, or forgotten over time.
